Bug Fix 2b (crm.py:1733-1736): team-members endpoint has is_active: {$ne: false} filter - CORRECT
Bug Fix 2c (demand_studio.py:2343-2346): marketing-partners endpoint has is_active: {$ne: false} filter - CORRECT
